---
title: "About"
---

I'm Navy, a mathematics and financial engineering student living in
Korea. Most of what I work on is quantitative finance, mainly FX: how
options on currencies get priced and quoted, how systematic strategies
hold up once real trading costs are counted, and where money crossing
borders leaves traces in the data. I'm also interested in applied machine
learning, in finance and in accessibility. This site collects the papers,
write-ups, and code that come out of all that.

Away from the numbers I draw comics and illustrations, do graphic and
UX/UI design, and build things for the web.
